verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 documents its own Files capability to "read and manage persistent files" in the sandbox. It ships Go, Python and TypeScript SDKs, and the product overview says agents can "manage files". The docs never explicitly tie file operations to the SDK, and upload and download are not described. The SSH/scp copy path is a different interface, not the SDK. Missing for 10: explicit SDK file read/write methods, documented upload and download operations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read, write, upload, and download files in the sandbox filesystem via the SDK

citations.quote: Read and manage persistent files without starting or resuming sandbox compute.
run code, install software, manage files, and control network access
Install SDK — Go: go get github.com/sandbox0-ai/sdk-go; Python: pip install sandbox0; TypeScript: npm install sandbox0.
